intent: Recover historical discoverable fronts with source lineage and no silent loss.
time_rules: source_time is the event's claimed time and may be UNKNOWN
observed_at is when this collector discovered the record
never backdate an inference or overwrite earlier evidence
record supersession without deleting the old version

echo_modes.chronological: Earliest accessible source first; preserve uncertainty.
echo_modes.dependency_first: Trace upstream receipts before downstream claims.
echo_modes.risk_first: Prioritize privacy, unsupported PASS, and custody failures.
echo_modes.inverse: Trace present artifacts back to earliest verified lineage.
echo_modes.predictive_retro: Current gaps nominate old sources to search, never proof of past execution.
echo_modes.counterfactual: Compare intent with observed outcomes; label hypotheses.

invariants: private content stays private; public projection must be redacted and authorized
unknown or missing dependency is HELD, not dropped
one fenced writer for conflicting writes; many independent challengers
no runtime PASS from proposal or synthetic tests
rebuild public view from independently readable permitted receipts
acceptance_tests: duplicate replay does not create duplicate work
changed digest preserves both versions and supersession
out-of-order discovery does not change source timestamps
orphan dependency becomes HELD with pointer
unverified claims cannot become verified effects
independent reader can restore public projection without original chat
next_gate: Implement collector and tests; execute them; receipt results; backfill accessible authorized sources.
